title: From a $25 Million Deal to $1.6 Billion
description:
He won 16 championships. Ten of them as an owner.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Magic Johnson: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magic_Johnson

From Wikipedia (Magic Johnson): he won 16 championships, one in college, five as an NBA player and ten as an owner; in 1981 he signed a 25-year, $25 million contract with the Lakers, the highest-paying contract in sports history up to that point; after his coaching stint, Jerry Buss sold him a 4% stake in the Lakers for $10 million; in 2012 his ownership group bought the Los Angeles Dodgers for $2 billion; in 2023 he invested $240 million in the group that bought the Washington Commanders; as of 2026 Forbes estimates his net worth at US$1.6 billion. Not financial advice.

cta: Player or owner? Comment which you'd be.

scenes.narration: He won 16 championships. Ten of them as an owner.
As a player, he signed sports' richest deal. 25 million dollars, for 25 years.
But he kept buying. First, a slice of his own team.
Then the Dodgers, for 2 billion. Then a piece of an NFL team.
Now Forbes says he's worth 1.6 billion dollars.
